answer: A payout is split thus 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The raven schedule is applied in sonnet and vault shows each instalment. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2673 identities would post 4919 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
